[element-target]
=== `<target>` Target of an Internal Link

May be placed anywhere within textual material such as a paragraph to provide a location (anchor) to which a cross reference can point.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
* <<attribute-target-type,`@target-type`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>> (REQUIRED)
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>
